fieldValues.title: Typed per-code details for ErrorReport (srs-rust#1342)
fieldValues.decision_question: Should ErrorReport.details be typed per error code, and by what mechanism, given ADR-011 (payload contract) and ADR-053 (one ErrorReport, codes as an explicit match)?
fieldValues.context:
Problem: ADR-053 ships ErrorReport.details as an open object derived from Serialize on RepositoryError and names a per-code typed union as a deferred follow-up (srs-rust#1342). Clients (srs-web, srs-vscode) that act on an error code cannot get its fields typed without hand-written types. Answers SP-03.
ADR review (revised 2026-10-24 with the owner): the first proposal framed option (b) as reversing ADR-011. Reviewed against its reasoning, ADR-011 passes for its core (payload structs, golden schemas, AJV in srs-vscode). Its one-line rule that schemars stays out of library crates was a side effect, with the stated reason of avoiding coupling, and it was already amended by ADR-037 (#1157): srs-repository has an optional mcp-schema feature on schemars 1, under the test that it adds no crate to any build. Only ADR-011's last Neutral bullet is stale (fixed separately). ADR-053 passes the review and governs.
Why (b) does not deliver: RepositoryError is #[serde(untagged)] and its code comes from the exhaustive code() match, not from serde. A schemars derive gives an anyOf of about 100 variant shapes with no code in them, many identical (just path, or id), so no branch is tied to a code. Six variants (ManifestRootContainer, MigrationRefused, ContainerStorage, ActorProvenance, InvalidPackageBundle, SliceRefused) carry their code dynamically, one variant to many codes. And the feature is schemars 1 (draft 2020-12) while the payload goldens are schemars 0.8 (draft-07).
Urgency: low, no consumer is blocked.
fieldValues.friction: The builder escalated this as a change to ADR-011, but the real constraint is ADR-053: codes live outside serde, so no derive can key a union on them. The recommended option could not have produced what the issue asks for.
fieldValues.alternatives_considered:
(a) Leave details open: nothing changes; clients keep hand-written types.
(b) schemars derive on RepositoryError behind the mcp-schema feature: does not produce a union keyed on code (untagged enum, code outside serde, six dynamic-code variants) and mixes JSON Schema drafts in the goldens. Rejected on the facts.
(c) Hand mirror of every variant in srs-cli with a drift test: keeps ADR-011, about 100 structs to maintain, most of which no client reads.
(d) Narrow mirror: declared mirror structs in srs-cli only for the codes a client acts on, pinned to RepositoryError by the round-trip test ADR-053 already uses for ErrorReportPayload; every other code keeps the open object. Follows ADR-048 rule 6 literally and the declared-twin form of rule 3.
(e) serde-tagged representation (tag = code, explicit per-variant renames) so serde and schemars produce the union directly: the full answer, but a refactor of RepositoryError and the six dynamic-code variants that needs its own ADR.
(f) Generator over code(): needs per-variant types to pair with codes, so it reduces to (c) or (e) plus tooling.
fieldValues.key_requirements: Wire unchanged: the ErrorReport envelope stays {code, message, details?}. ADR-053 holds: codes stay an explicit match, never derived from variant names; adapters carry the report unchanged. ADR-048 rule 6: every fact a consumer acts on is a typed field. ADR-048 rule 3: a mirror exists only with its parity gate. ADR-011: the golden schema is the contract, regenerated and committed. The published schema only narrows (additive for consumers), which is still a payload contract change and so the owner's under decision 0b1c25b1.
fieldValues.decision_statement: ErrorReport.details is typed for the error codes a client acts on, by declared mirror structs in srs-cli pinned to RepositoryError by a round-trip test, and every other code keeps the open details object.
fieldValues.rationale: It types exactly the facts consumers act on (ADR-048 rule 6) using the parity-gated mirror pattern ADR-053 already uses, keeps the library crates and ADR-011 as they are, and grows with real demand rather than with all ~100 variants. The full union (e) stays available as a separate ADR when demand justifies the refactor.
fieldValues.revisit_when: When the typed codes pass about ten, or a consumer needs the full union: then propose (e), a serde-tagged RepositoryError, as its own ADR. Also if a round-trip test is found to have let a mirror drift.
fieldValues.next_steps: Owner rules. If (d): amend ADR-053 section 4 to name the narrow union (owner-merge PR), then relabel srs-rust#1342 ready; the builder types the codes named by srs-web#512, srs-vscode#131 and srs-rust#1247 first. ADR-011 stale bullet: separate srs-rust docs PR. Keep srs-rust#1339 parked until srs-rust#1264 lands.
